description: (needs account token) Moves one domain off a site that has several, onto a new site that shows a coming-soon page. confirm=true applies it. Does not charge.

confirm.description: True applies the change. False leaves it unchanged and the reply describes what would change.

domain.description: The domain to split off. One of the domains already on the site.

site.description: The address of a site on this account, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.
